questions.question: In Microsoft Word, ________ view shows formatting such as line spacing, font, point size, and italics.
questions.solution:
• In Microsoft Word, Normal Layout view shows formatting such as line spacing, font, point size, and italics.
 
• The normal layout is also known as the normal.dotm layout (in recent versions) and opens whenever Microsoft Word is started.
 
• It includes default customizations and styles which affect the look of the document.

questions.question:
Which of the statements given below is correct?

A) Henri Kontinen and John Peers won the Tennis 2017 ATP World Tour Finals Men's Doubles.

B) In 2017, Sebastian Vettel raced in MotoGP for Honda.

C) Daniel Ricciardo won the Formula One 2017 Chinese Grand Prix.
questions.solution:
• Henri Kontinen and John Peers defeated Lukasz Kubot and Marcelo Melo in the finals by, 6-4, 6-2, to win the 2017 ATP World Tour Finals Men’s Doubles.
 
• MotoGP is a motorcycle racing World Championship and Sebastian Vettel is a car racing driver.
 
• Lewis Hamilton won the 2017 Chinese Grand while Daniel Ricciardo came in 5th.
 
• Therefore, only option A is correct.

questions.question: Where warm air rises up, the air ________.

options.text: pressure at that place is lowered
pressure at that place is raised
humidity at that place is lowered
humidity at that place is raised

questions.solution:
• Where warm air rises up, the air pressure at that place is lower.
 
• The density of warm air is less which causes it to rise and this creates an area of low pressure.
 
• Conversely, the density of cold air is more which causes it to sink thus creating an area of high pressure.

questions.question: When an object travels equal distances in equal intervals of time, it moves with ________ speed.
questions.solution:
__**CONCEPT**__:

 
• **Linear motion**: When an object is moving on a straight line then the motion of the object is called linear motion.
 
• **Translational motion**: When the object moves from one place to another without any rotation of the object then this type of motion is called translational motion.
 
• **Uniform speed**: When the object is moving on a path with constant speed then this type of speed is called uniform speed.
 
 
• When an **object travels equal distances in equal intervals of time,** it moves with uniform speed.

questions.question: On 20 July 2017, Lok Sabha passed IIIT-PPP Bill, 2017. The Bill seeks to allow how many IITs established on a PPP model to grant degrees and get statutory status?
questions.solution:
• Lok Sabha passed the IIIT-PPP Bill on 20th July 2017.
 
• This bill attempts to allow the establishment of 15 IITs (Indian Institute of Technology) on the PPP (Public Private Partnership) model to grant degrees and get a statutory status.
 
• It also attempts to grant the IITs and NITs (National Institute of Technology) with the Institute of national importance status.

questions.question: In August 2017, Essar Oil Limited was acquired by Rosneft PJSC for nearly how much amount?
questions.solution:
• In August 2017 Essar Oil Limited was acquired by Russia’s Rosneft PJSC for nearly $13 billion.
 
• Rosneftbought 49% of the stake and another 49% was equally split between Netherlands-based Trafigura Group Pte and United Capital Partners.
 
• The deal was a way for Essar Oil to reduce its debt and has been termed as the largest foreign investment in India.

questions.question: What is the name of world’s first typhoid vaccine that has received pre-qualification from the World Health Organisation?
questions.solution:
• TypbarTCV is the name of the world’s first typhoid vaccine that has received pre-qualification from the World Health Organization.
 
• This tag makes the Typhoid Conjugate Vaccine eligible for procurement by UN agencies like PAHO, UNICEF and GAVI supported countries.
 
• The vaccine was developed by Bharat Biotech and received the pre-qualification on January 3, 2018, at Hyderabad, Genome Valley.

questions.question: Who launched ‘PENCIL’ portal in September 2017 for the prevention of child labour?
questions.solution:
• On 26th September 2017, Rajnath Singh, the Home Minister of India, launched the ‘PENCIL’ portal at the National Conference on Child Labour at Pravasi Bhartiya Kendra, Chanakya Puri, New Delhi.
 
• PENCIL stands for Portal For Effective Enforcement For No Child Labour.
 
• This portal is an electronic platform that seeks to achieve a child labour free society as per the National Child Labour Project Scheme started in 1988 by involving the general public, civil services, Centre, State and District Governments.

questions.question: The olfactory receptors in human beings detect ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the__ smell.__

**__CONCEPT:__**

__
 
• **Receptors** are the organs or cells which respond to light, heat, or external stimulus and transmit the signal to the sensory nerve.
 
• The smell receptors known as chemoreceptors are present in the **Olfactory Epithelium **in the nose.
 
• Olfactory receptors are located in our noses.
 
• The olfactory system allows the human body to detect and process smell.
 
• These are also known as smell receptors and are capable of binding odor molecules.
 
• Most of the olfactory receptors are found on the superior or external surface of the nasal cavity.
 
• Olfactory receptors are present in the nose and are responsible for giving rise to the sense of smell.

**EXPLANATION:**__

Olfactory epithelium:

 
• The olfactory receptors in human beings detect smell.
 
• Olfactory receptors are proteins that exist as clusters at the back of the nasal cavity and interact with odor molecules thus playing a role in smelling.

 
• The organ of smell is a yellow-tinged patch of the pseudostratified epithelium (olfactory epithelium) located on the roof of the nasal cavity.
 
• Air entering the nasal cavity must make a hairpin turn to stimulate olfactory receptors before entering the respiratory passageway
 
• This is why sniffing, which draws more air superiorly across the olfactory epithelium, intensifies the sense of smell.

questions.question: What is the process by which autotrophs take in substances from the outside and convert them into stored form of energy?
questions.solution:
• Photosynthesis is the process by which autotrophs take inorganic substances from the outsideand convert them into organic substanceswhich are stored form of energy.
 
• Plants use light energy from the sun to convert carbon dioxide and water into simple sugars which are a source of energy.
 
• The equation for photosynthesis:

 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + light energy = C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂

questions.question: How many All India Services are there in India?
questions.solution:
__
 
• There are three **All India Services in India**__.
 
• These include the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), the Indian Forest Service (IFS) and the Indian Police Service (IPS) which are all Civil services of India.The officers can be allotted to any department, government or ministry.
 
• **Other services are allotted particular ministries and can only be on deputation in other ministries.**

questions.question:
Whose salary is charged on the consolidated fund of India?

I. Chairman of UPSC

II. President of India

III. Judges of Supreme Court
questions.solution:
• The above-mentioned government officials are charged salaries from the consolidated fund of India without the approval of the Parliament.
 
• Consolidated fund is a term that is used to describe the main bank account of the government in many countries.
 
• According to Article 266 (1) of the Indian Constitution, all the revenues received by the government through loans or direct or indirect taxes flow into the consolidated fund.
 
• Consolidated Fund includes revenues received by the government as well as the expenses made by it.

questions.question:
Fe₂O₃ + 2Al ⟶ Al₂O₃ + 2Fe

The above reaction is an example of ________.
questions.solution:
__Concept:__

Chemical Reactions:

__
 
• A process in which one or more compounds are formed as products completely different from the reacting substances is known as a chemical reaction.
 
• There is generally a change in heat, colour, or appearance when a chemical reaction takes place.
 
• The evolution of gas may also occur.
 
• A chemical reaction may be reversible or irreversible in nature.

Types of Chemical Reactions-

The basis for different types of reactions is the product formed, the changes that occur, the reactants involved, and so on. Different types of reactions are

 
• Combustion reaction
 
• Decomposition reaction
 
• Neutralization reaction
 
• Precipitation or Double-Displacement Reaction

Neutralization reaction:

 
• The reaction of an acid with a base to give salt and water is called a neutralization reaction.
 
• Example is:

NaOH (strong base) + HCl (strong acid) → ​NaCl + H2O

Oxidation reaction:

 
• Oxidation Reaction refers to a reaction in which either the addition of Oxygen takes place or the removal of Hydrogen takes place.
 
• It can also be said as the process of loss of one or more electrons by atoms or ions.
 
• Example is:

Mg + O2 = Mg2O

Reduction Reaction:

 
• Reduction Reaction refers to a reaction in which either the addition of Hydrogen takes place or the removal of oxygen takes place.

 
• In the process of reduction, a chemical species also gains electrons.
 
• It is the reverse of the oxidation reaction.
 
• Example is:

H2 + F2 → HF

Exothermic reaction:

 
• It is a type of reaction where heat or energy is produced.
 
• For example, in the synthesis of ammonia from nitrogen and hydrogen.

N2 + 3H2 → 2NH3

Explanation:__

A chemical reaction in which a less reactive element is displaced from its compound by a more reactive element is known as a __**displacement reaction.**__

 
• In the given reaction Fe (Less reactive element) of Fe₂O₃ gets displaced by Al (More reactive element).

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol of cobalt?
questions.solution:
• The chemical symbol of cobalt is **Co.**
 
• Its atomic number is 27 and it comes under group 9 and period 4 of the periodic table.
 
• A ferromagnetic metal, cobalt is mostly found in the Earth’s crust in combined forms such as alloys.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a classical dance?
questions.solution:

• It is a folk dance that is performed exclusively by women in the Punjab region of India and Pakistan.

• Classical Dances of India- Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Mohiniyattam, Odissi, Sattriya, Manipuri are the recognized Indian classical dance forms.

questions.question: Where is New Moore Island located?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **New Moore Island**__ was a small, uninhabited island located in the Bay of Bengal.
 
• The island was off the coast of the Ganges-Brahmaputra delta, approximately 2 km from the mouth of the Hariabhanga river.
 
• Also known as South Talpatti, the island emerged in 1970 after cyclone Bhola.
 
• It disappeared in 2010 due to rising sea levels.

questions.question: Who is the exponent of Continental Drift Theory?
questions.solution:
• The exponent of the Continental Drift Theory is Alfred Wegener.
 
• This theory states that the continents on Earth have moved relative to each other over geologic time thus appearing as though they have drifted across the ocean bed.
 
• While the idea was first presented by Abraham Ortelius in 1596, the full, developed theory was given by Alfred Wegener in 1912.

questions.question: Which of the following dynasties was not located in South India?
questions.solution:
• The Kalachuri dynasty established in the 7th century, ruled parts of Central India until the 13th century.
 
• They were also known as Kalachuris of Tripuri as Tripuri (present-day Tewar, near Jabalpur) was their capital.
 
• Chedi region (also known as Dahala-mandala) was the core territory of this dynasty.

questions.question: Paper currency first started in India in the year________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• The earliest paper currency in India was issued by both private as well as semi-government banks like General Bank of Bengal and Bihar (1773-1775) and Bank of Hindostan (1770-1832).
 
• In **1861**__, the Paper Currency Act was enacted by the Government of India which gave the government the sole right to create and issue paper currency.

questions.question: Investment in public work is known as ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e __**Capital Expenditure,**__

 
• Investment in public work is known as** capital expenditure**.
 
• Public works include infrastructure projects like buildings, equipment, etc.
 
• In simple terms, the amount spent for repairing, buying, updating, or improving a company’s long-term assets like equipment, business or buildings is known as capital expenditure.
